cases.name: Linda Ann O’Keefe
cases.about:
Her big sister Cindy Borgeson said, “I remember she was an old soul,” Borgeson said. “When we’d go camping she was like the frog whisperer. We’d be trying to chase frogs and get them but she would walk up very gently and pick them up, like they just knew she was a safe person to with.

“And I was always astonished with that.”

cases.narrative: She was abducted while walking home from summer school by a man in a van and her body was found in the Back Bay the next morning.
